mapper.insert: INSERT INTO realised_pnl_entry ( order_id, account_id, ticker_symbol, quantity, fill_price, average_cost_at_sale, realised_pnl, currency, booked_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{accountId}, #{tickerSymbol}, #{quantity}, #{fillPrice}, #{averageCostAtSale}, #{realisedPnl}, #{currency}, #{bookedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.account_id = #{accountId} AND o.order_status = 'FILLED' AND o.order_type = 'SELL' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM realised_pnl_entry r WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id)

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status = 'FILLED' AND o.order_type = 'SELL' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM realised_pnl_entry r WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id) ORDER BY o.account_id
SELECT i.instrument_ticker, h.quantity, h.purchase_price FROM holdings h JOIN instrument i ON i.instrument_id = h.instrument_id WHERE h.account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT o.order_id, i.instrument_ticker, o.order_type, o.quantity, o.price, o.transaction_date FROM orders o JOIN instrument i ON i.instrument_id = o.instrument_id WHERE o.account_id = #{accountId} AND o.order_status = 'FILLED' ORDER BY o.transaction_date ASC, o.order_id ASC
